# @cortex-ui/source-manager-settings-backup

Settings > Backup & Sync: the GitHub repository the live data's changes (skills, prompts, texts) are pushed to, back up now, restore.

- **Plugin id:** `source-manager.settings-backup`
- **Slot:** `settings.backup@1`
- **Build:** `npm run build` → `dist/` (`index.js`, `style.css`, `manifest.json`)

React, ReactDOM and `@cortex/sdk` are peer dependencies the workbench provides.

<!-- slot-contract:start (generated by ui/scripts/readme-contracts.mjs) -->
## Slot contract

- **Fills:** `settings.backup@1` as `source-manager.settings-backup`
- **Props:** none besides `slot`
- **Hosts:** no slots
- **Workbench state read:** none
- **Workbench state written:** `settings.open`
- **Own durable state (survives hot swaps):** none
- **Frame methods called:** `source.backup.push`, `source.backup.restore`, `source.backup.set`, `source.backup.status`, `vcs.github.repo.create`, `vcs.github.repos`, `vcs.github.status`
- **Topics followed:** `source.changed`

Styles use the theme's tokens and primitives only (`ui/verify/tokens.mjs` checks). Nothing is
imported from the renderer or from another plugin: the package builds alone (`ui/verify/standalone.mjs`).
<!-- slot-contract:end -->
